what: An accent-color band passes through the text once from right to left, painting pale gray text into dark text (background-clip: text, gradient position 100% → 0, 1s ease). Titles run once on reaching 70% of the screen (phone 80%). Links run the same band while hovered and return it when released (base type: dark text → band → dark text)

options.trigger: scroll (default) · hover · load · "scroll hover" — Whether to paint once on scroll, paint while a hand is over it, or paint once delay seconds after opening
options.start: Scroll trigger point — where the element’s top edge sits from the top of the screen in % (default 70)
options.start-sm: Position that turns on below 768px (default 80) — if start is given, it follows that
options.dur: Length of time the strip takes to pass (sec), default 1 — original links use .7, some large titles use 2
options.look: base: Dark text → band → dark text (44.44%·55.55%, 225%) — hover link
options.look: contrast: On a dark panel — light text (--kf-contrast-ink) → band → pale text
options.look: contrast-base: Hover link on a dark panel — light text → band → light text
options.--fx-band: Band color (via style), default --kf-accent — for a different band color per product
options.--fx-base: Text color after painting (via style), default --kf-ink
options.--fx-rest: Text color before painting (via style), default --kf-dim
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Child text to paint (optional) — for a link mixed with other children like an arrow, attach it to the text span only. If none, the whole element is painted
options.delay: Delays the start (seconds), default 0 — for both scroll and load. For painting the title, subtitle and body of the same panel in sequence
options.look: wide: Wide band (35%~65%, 300%) — pale text → band at 30% of the text width → dark text. Brand section title is dur .4 · delay .5 · start 80 · --fx-ease: linear · --fx-rest: var(--kf-raised)
options.look: wipe: Two colors split half and half with no band (50%, 200%) — pale text sweeps away from the right and turns into dark text
options.look: wipe-down: Wipe from top to bottom (100% 200%, vertical-writing title)
options.trigger-el: Ancestor selector to measure when triggering on scroll (optional) — when title, subtitle and body enter in one panel, trigger them together and stagger with delay
options.look: sheen: A gradient where three colors join smoothly with no bands (8% · 33% · 66%, 300%) — light from the pale end color (--fx-rest) to the middle color (--fx-band) passes through as it settles from --fx-base → --fx-band. The feature section’s English title uses dur 2 · start 80 · --fx-ease: ease-in-out · --fx-base/--fx-band/--fx-rest as three blue-gray colors
options.look: ember: Edge-blurred band (painted color 0~30% → band 40% → unpainted color 50~100%, 350%) — the Brand title uses dur 1.4 · start 75 · --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(.455,.03,.515,.955) (power1.inOut) · multiple lines are applied per line with delay .12 each. With --fx-rest: transparent, the letters appear as if blazing up out of darkness
